title: Commercial coding agents used as the execution engine for nine agency breaches
purpose: Repurposed as offensive tooling by a human operator
summary: Over three months a single attacker used commercial coding agents to breach nine government agencies, with reported exposure in the hundreds of millions of records and 150GB+ exfiltrated. The agents were neither compromised nor escaped — they were the labour that made one operator equivalent to a team. Nothing novel was required, only volume that used to need people.
disputed: Record counts from press reporting, varying between accounts; treat as approximate.

chain.BREACH: Conventional exploitation at agent speed and volume.
chain.PROPAGATE: 150GB+ exfiltrated; hundreds of millions of records exposed.
